title: Taylor Swift celebrates epic Knicks win during Game 4 of NBA Finals
text:
Page Six confirmed that the Grammy winner would be attending the highly anticipated game just hours before tip-off.
Just moments after the Knicks defeated the Spurs in Game 4 Wednesday night — pulling off the greatest comeback in Finals history! —jumping up and down with Mariska Hargitay on the court just moments after the NY-based team won the game 107-106.
She was also seen in a separate videoThe Knicks and Spurs will face off again for Game 5 on Saturday at 8:30 p.m. ET. Taylor Swift attended Game 4 of the 2026 NBA Finals between the New York Knicks and San Antonio Spurs in New York City Monday night.
Page Six exclusively confirmed that Swift, 36, would be attending the highly anticipated match with friends just hours before tip-off.attended a Cleveland Cavaliers game“She’s a huge fan of the Knicks and really wants to be there to support them,” a source told us about Swift . The Kansas City Chiefs tight end, who is a native of Ohio, addressed the frenzy, insisting that he wasn’t “trying to persuade Taylor into being a Cleveland sports fan” with him.
“This was me just having a fun date night knowing that I love going to basketball games,” he said on his “New Heights” podcast. “We actually tried to go to a game in New York but I was stuck in Kansas City. I love bringing her into the sports world that I appreciate. ” Kelce, 36, admitted it was difficult to witness the Cavaliers lose but shared he would “be rooting” for the Knicks “from here on out.

Swift and Travis Kelce are set to tie the knot at the Knicks’ home base in Manhattan. According to TMZ, the venue costs $1 million per day, and the duo is reportedly renting it out for three days.
